compiler.sampled: evaluate final stack at shared sample times
compiler.continuousCertified: adaptive-sample final stack to a single error-bounded LUT

acceptance: single weight-1 layer equals legacy easing
weight zero removes only that contribution
disabled layer removes only that contribution
deleting a layer preserves other layers and key endpoints
reordering layers does not change v1.4 numeric result
overshoot is preserved until property-level clamping
save/reload preserves layer ids, weights, enabled flags, curve parameters and order
Scratch and Web reproduce the same compiled final curve
